projects.title: Claude Orchestrator
projects.summary: Local control plane that runs Claude Code tasks across several accounts, with a queue, a live board and a fail-closed SQL permission gate.
projects.description: Running many agent tasks from a terminal is awkward: one account's limits cap throughput, nothing stops an agent before it changes a schema, and you only see what happened after the fact. The orchestrator queues tasks across account pools, streams each task's raw events to a live board, and hooks Claude Code's PreToolUse event to classify every SQL statement an agent is about to run, holding the call open until a human answers. Hooks it cannot correlate to a task are denied.
highlights: PreToolUse gate that classifies SQL before it runs, not after
Fails closed: uncorrelated tool calls are denied
Queue + live board across multiple account pools
